threatModel.summary: WMS is a Django/DRF monolith covering accounts, master data, inbound/outbound work, inventory, warehouse tasks, POS, billing, reporting and a consumer sales miniapp. Browser sessions serve Admin/console; JWT APIs serve PDA, Android, owner-sales, boss and consumer clients. Production Compose defines Gunicorn web and a separate billing scheduler, with the same environment, UID 10001, database authority and media/static volumes; optional expiry/reconciliation commands run separately. Main entry points are explicit URL registrations, not merely installed applications. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:134-168; wmsmaster/urls.py:24-82; compose.production.yml:3-46; docker/start-web.sh:4-9; docker/start-scheduler.sh:4. This is architecture mapping, not completed vulnerability coverage.
assets: Owner/warehouse records, orders, stock balances and movements, task state, POS transactions, invoices and reports; authorization combines capability permissions with explicit tenant scopes. Evidence: allapp/accounts/models.py:60-83; allapp/accounts/access.py:15-20,44-127,198-231.

User credentials, Django sessions, access/refresh tokens, role memberships and audit records. Standard JWT access lifetime is 15 minutes with seven-day rotating refresh tokens; the PDA issuance path instead produces 24-hour access tokens. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:173-201; wmsmaster/auth_views.py:24-33,78-106,109-139.

WeChat customer bindings, addresses, payment/refund state and merchant signing/decryption authority. Private-key path takes precedence over inline key material; production platform verification keys are selected by serial number. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/salemini_api.py:532-574,596-610; allapp/salesapp/services_wechat_pay.py:51-101,142-173,328-364.

ApiZero integration credentials are encrypted in SystemSetting.value. The encryption key comes from SYSTEM_SETTING_ENCRYPTION_KEY or a deterministic derivation from SECRET_KEY, so these are not necessarily independent key authorities. Evidence: allapp/core/models.py:19-30,126-155,176-216.

Uploaded review images resolve to MEDIA_ROOT/sale-mini/reviews/<review_id>/<uuid>.<validated suffix>; public APK distribution reads BASE_DIR/media/bv2.apk. In Compose both are in /app/media backed by the wms-media volume. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/models.py:19-23,1111-1118; allapp/api/views.py:22-35; wmsmaster/settings.py:515-521; compose.production.yml:9-11.

Logical preserved-data backup bundles contain database data, including privileged identity/configuration tables selected by the transfer manifest. Bundle files are <operator-selected absolute output>/preserved-data.sql.gz and manifest.json; directory mode is 0700 and files 0600. Temporary MySQL option files contain connection credentials and are mode 0600. Evidence: allapp/core/preserved_data_transfer.py:34-36,295-328,403-440,457-493; allapp/core/management/commands/backup_preserved_data.py:26-57.

Published container images, build provenance, deployment SSH authority, backup executables, application environment and host-managed TLS/media serving. These are operator/CI privileges rather than capabilities granted to ordinary WMS users. Evidence: Dockerfile:23-28; .github/workflows/ci.yml:590-655,666-705; docker/production_release.sh:13-16,37-65.
trustBoundaries: Unauthenticated callers cross login boundaries into accounts.User identity. Credential login uses database-backed username/IP and IP throttles; refresh rejects inactive users and password-hash mismatches. Browser requests additionally encounter Django session, CSRF and clickjacking middleware; API defaults are JWTAuthentication plus IsAuthenticated, with explicit public endpoint exceptions. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:175-201,263-273,359-369; allapp/accounts/throttling.py:19-50; wmsmaster/auth_views.py:82-139; allapp/salesapp/salemini_api.py:2121,2137,3444,3573.

Authenticated business capability and row scope are separate controls. Groups/permissions grant operations; AccessScope resolves owner/warehouse reach from active UserRoleScope rows, rejects missing/conflicting bindings and grants global scope only to superusers. Admin has explicit model-to-tenant policies and separate cross-owner product capabilities. Coverage of every caller still requires audit. Evidence: allapp/accounts/models.py:60-66; allapp/accounts/access.py:44-127,198-231; allapp/core/admin_tenant.py:19-48,55-100.

Miniapp customer identity is bound through the official WeChat code exchange, existing customer/owner relationships and active accounts. Public catalog/review browsing is intentionally separate from authenticated purchase/review actions; review mutations resolve purchases belonging to the caller. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/salemini_api.py:532-574,596-610; allapp/salesapp/salemini_review_api.py:64-111,159-172,203-210.

External ApiZero and WeChat requests transmit different authorities to distinct recipients. ApiZero receives a GS1 code and decrypted API key in an HTTPS query; WeChat login receives app secret and authorization code; WeChat Pay receives signed requests. Each initial destination is validated by require_https_endpoint, which enforces HTTPS, allowlisted host, port 443 and no URL credentials/query/fragment. Redirect behavior is delegated to urllib and was not resolved here. Evidence: allapp/products/gs1.py:113-149; allapp/salesapp/salemini_api.py:532-554; allapp/salesapp/services_wechat_pay.py:185-214; allapp/core/url_security.py:10-33.

Public payment callbacks transfer provider-authenticated event authority into payment processing. Cryptographic controls include serial-specific RSA verification, default 300-second callback timestamp tolerance and AES-GCM resource decryption. Production system checks reject disabled verification or missing payment settings, whereas the direct Gunicorn startup script contains no explicit system-check invocation. Exact deployment path therefore matters. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/services_wechat_pay.py:73-85,142-156,328-364; allapp/salesapp/checks.py:56-104; docker/start-web.sh:4-9; docker/production_release.sh:39.

Untrusted review image uploads cross into filesystem storage through authenticated buyer ownership, a five-MiB limit, JPEG/PNG/WebP validation and generated filenames. Publication lists use published_reviews; actual production media access is delegated to a web server absent from the inspected deployment definitions. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/salemini_review_api.py:28-30,104-111,135-156,159-172; allapp/salesapp/models.py:19-23; sales-miniapp/README.md:28-32; wmsmaster/urls.py:90-91.

Mobile/browser bearer-token transport has materially different controls: wmspda hard-selects an HTTP LAN endpoint; Android permits a configured HTTP endpoint and generates a host-specific cleartext exception; boss/owner/consumer clients use a stricter configured endpoint policy, with same-origin H5 support. Device storage and deployed build artifacts remain external trust assumptions. Evidence: wmspda/utils/request.js:5-17,19-48; wmspda/vite.config.js:1-8; wmsandroid/utils/request.js:1-18; wmsandroid/vite.config.js:31-49; wmsandroid/config/androidNetworkSecurity.mjs:1-22; frontend/api-base-policy.mjs:21-48; wmsbossbilling/utils/api-base.js:20-47; sales-miniapp/utils/api-base.js:41-47.

Web, scheduler and optional maintenance containers share the same application environment and writable media/static volumes. No independent database or secret isolation is established merely by separate Compose service names. Systemd expiry/reconciliation units invoke those Compose services and share a host flock path. Evidence: compose.production.yml:3-46; deploy/systemd/wms-sale-mini-expire.service:8-12; deploy/systemd/wms-sale-mini-reconcile.service:8-12.

Privileged offline backup/restore crosses from operator-provided bundle paths into MySQL tools. Commands default to dry-run; execution requires exact target confirmation, maintenance assertions and eligible operator identity. Restore checks a freshly migrated target and acquires a database maintenance lock. These checks supplement existing shell/database authority rather than authenticate a remote user. Evidence: allapp/core/management/commands/backup_preserved_data.py:26-57,87-99; allapp/core/management/commands/restore_preserved_data.py:25-41,44-77,103-119; allapp/core/preserved_data_transfer.py:295-328,587-657,696-746.

CI publishing requires the aggregate release gate and a main-branch push; the build job receives registry authority, scans and publishes a SHA candidate, resolves its digest and attests provenance. Staging deployment uses SSH with a supplied known-hosts file. Production release separately invokes operator-supplied backup scripts, migrations, static collection, readiness checks and reconciliation. Evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:554-588,590-655,666-705; docker/production_release.sh:8-16,37-87.
attackerCapabilities: An unauthenticated network caller can reach explicitly public health, credential/WeChat login, product/review browsing, payment callback and APK download interfaces if the deployment exposes them. It does not initially possess an account, merchant key, database credential, filesystem write access or CI authority. Evidence: wmsmaster/urls.py:24-79; allapp/api/views.py:15-39; allapp/salesapp/salemini_urls.py:40-130.

An authenticated warehouse/owner user can submit API identifiers, quantities and business actions and inspect data within assigned capability and owner/warehouse scope. A meaningful boundary failure would add operations or cross-scope access; merely exercising an authorized operation is not a security failure. Evidence: allapp/accounts/access.py:44-127,198-231; allapp/accounts/models.py:158-169.

A bound miniapp customer can manipulate their cart/order/review requests and upload review images; they do not automatically acquire another customer's binding or staff workflow authority. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/salemini_api.py:501-522,596-610; allapp/salesapp/salemini_review_api.py:64-111,135-156.

A network intermediary matters where a deployed client actually uses plaintext HTTP. Repository wmspda and configurable Android transport establish conditional surfaces, but interception capability, deployed artifacts and warehouse network trust were not established. Evidence: wmspda/utils/request.js:5-13; wmsandroid/config/androidNetworkSecurity.mjs:14-22.

Repository contributors, CI maintainers, host operators and holders of database/secret files have different existing privileges from application users. They must not be modeled as low-privilege attackers for actions already enabled by their source, host or database authority. Evidence: Dockerfile:24; .github/workflows/ci.yml:595-609,679-705; allapp/core/management/commands/restore_preserved_data.py:25-41.
securityObjectives: Preserve separate operation permissions and owner/warehouse row boundaries across APIs, Admin, exports and all business mutation callers; fail closed for unbound/conflicting accounts. Evidence: allapp/accounts/access.py:44-127,198-231; allapp/core/admin_tenant.py:64-100.
Preserve stock/order/payment integrity and actor attribution across concurrent business operations; architecture inspection alone does not establish correctness of every transaction or failure path.

Keep session, JWT, database, integration and merchant credentials restricted to their intended consumers; model fallback-derived system-setting encryption keys and shared container environments accurately. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:182-201,346-369; allapp/core/models.py:19-30; compose.production.yml:3-11.

Accept payment state transitions only from authorized customer/operator workflows or validated provider events, with merchant/order/amount/idempotency invariants requiring downstream audit beyond the cryptographic boundary inspected here. Evidence: allapp/salesapp/services_wechat_pay.py:142-173,328-364.

Use explicit production configuration, validated hosts/origins, secure cookies, HTTPS and a correctly trusted reverse proxy. The production profile is selected by APP_ENV; it is not inferred from running Gunicorn or Compose. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:41-48,92-98,123-126,282-286,444-473,512-514.

User-supplied operational constraint: automated database work must use MySQL 8 and may write destructively only to the exactly validated wms_db_test, never wms_db. This architecture review performed no database connection, application execution or source modification.

Maintain reviewable, target-bound deployment and maintenance workflows, protect sensitive backup artifacts and preserve useful audit evidence without credential material. Evidence: docker/production_release.sh:8-16,37-87; allapp/core/management/commands/restore_preserved_data.py:103-119; allapp/core/preserved_data_transfer.py:295-328,403-493.
assumptions: Scope supplied by the parent is the entire current /wms worktree, including dirty/untracked source. No user-supplied threat model or root SECURITY.md was supplied. This review used offline source only; live configuration, infrastructure controls, runtime behavior and test results were not verified.

Production Compose imports /etc/wms/wms.env unless WMS_ENV_FILE overrides it; the file contents and actual deployment environment were not inspected. APP_ENV defaults to development when absent, while documentation requires production/preproduction DEBUG=False. Strict production behavior is conditional on the effective APP_ENV. Evidence: compose.production.yml:5-6; wmsmaster/settings.py:41-48,92-98,123-126; docs/release-test-plan.md:54-56.

Local environment precedence is existing process variables, then .env.test.local for test commands or explicit APP_ENV=test, then .env. Contrary to the settings comment's shorthand about ordinary commands, an explicit APP_ENV=test also loads the test file for a non-test command. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:33-38; wmsmaster/environment.py:22-35.

The documented release surface mentions Redis, but actual configured application caches are per-process LocMemCache and the MySQL table wms_login_throttle_cache. Do not assume Redis provides shared-cache isolation, locking or throttling. Evidence: docs/release-test-plan.md:40; wmsmaster/settings.py:359-369.

The settings comment says USE_TZ ensures timezone support, while the consumed value is False with TIME_ZONE=Asia/Shanghai. Scheduler and payment timestamp behavior should be interpreted from actual code and deployment timezone, not that comment. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:394-397.

API endpoint policies are not uniform across clients. wmspda's chosen destination is http://192.168.1.6:8001 regardless of its computed miniapp environment; Android intentionally permits a configured host-specific HTTP exception; boss-client documentation promises HTTPS outside loopback development and its runtime validator enforces that policy. Evidence: wmspda/utils/request.js:1-13; wmsandroid/config/androidNetworkSecurity.mjs:10-22; wmsbossbilling/README.md:23-27; wmsbossbilling/utils/api-base.js:20-47.

Public-media serving and TLS termination are documented host obligations; the Compose file publishes web only on host loopback and defines no reverse proxy. Debug-only Django media routing does not establish production confidentiality or publication controls. Evidence: sales-miniapp/README.md:28; compose.production.yml:18-19; wmsmaster/urls.py:90-91.

Payment verification defaults differ by environment. Production checks reject disabled verification, but the direct Gunicorn startup script does not explicitly run checks; the production-release and staging paths do. Deployment-specific effective enforcement must be distinguished from checker availability. Evidence: wmsmaster/settings.py:240-247; allapp/salesapp/checks.py:56-71; docker/start-web.sh:4-9; docker/production_release.sh:39; .github/workflows/ci.yml:695.

Docker copies the entire allowed build context. .dockerignore includes *.env but does not explicitly list .env.test.local or **/.env.local; filename-only inspection found such local files. Actual build inclusion and presence of sensitive values were not tested, and a clean CI checkout can differ from a dirty local build. Evidence: Dockerfile:24; .dockerignore:15-29.

Caller-selected payment key paths and backup output paths cannot be resolved to actual host locations without deployment/operator values. Compose provides only media/static mounts, so a configured key path is not evidence that the key is mounted or readable. Evidence: compose.production.yml:9-11; allapp/salesapp/services_wechat_pay.py:51-84; allapp/core/preserved_data_transfer.py:410-419.

Native Android/PDA SDK archives and released mobile binaries are separate opaque implementation artifacts; this pass did not inspect their internal controls. No remote driver API exposure is inferred merely from the installed driverapp.
Repository citations were read at the stated locations and batch-checked for file existence and line bounds.

resolved_questions.question: Are tenant scope and operational capabilities the same authorization mechanism?
resolved_questions.resolution: No. Explicit UserRoleScope controls row reach; Django permissions independently grant operations. Superuser global scope is explicit.

resolved_questions.question: Does OUTBOUND_LEGACY_AUTHZ_MODE=shadow bypass rejected writes?
resolved_questions.resolution: The inspected require_legacy_action implementation logs shadow telemetry and still raises PermissionDenied.

resolved_questions.question: Does documented Redis infrastructure own login throttling?
resolved_questions.resolution: Documentation lists Redis, while effective settings select MySQL DatabaseCache for login throttling and LocMemCache otherwise. Both facts must remain in the model.

resolved_questions.question: Does Compose or Gunicorn automatically select production security settings?
resolved_questions.resolution: No automatic inference is present. APP_ENV defaults to development; Compose supplies an external common env file. Production documentation requires DEBUG=False, but actual deployment values are unknown.

resolved_questions.question: Do all mobile clients share the same HTTPS-only destination control?
resolved_questions.resolution: No. Current PDA source hard-selects a LAN HTTP base; Android generates a configured-host HTTP exception; boss and consumer validators implement the stricter HTTPS policy. Deployment evidence is required before claiming live transport exposure.

resolved_questions.question: Are PDA access tokens governed by the regular 15-minute setting?
resolved_questions.resolution: The distinct PDA token class sets a one-day lifetime; ordinary tokens use the settings value.

resolved_questions.question: Is the public APK request filename a filesystem selector?
resolved_questions.resolution: No. The file read is fixed at BASE_DIR/media/bv2.apk; the path variable affects the attachment filename.

resolved_questions.question: Are review-upload paths opaque or resolved?
resolved_questions.resolution: The full derived path is MEDIA_ROOT/sale-mini/reviews/<review_id>/<uuid>.<suffix>, mapping to /wms/media locally and /app/media in Compose. Production server behavior remains external.

resolved_questions.question: Does the production payment check always run on web startup?
resolved_questions.resolution: Release and staging scripts explicitly run check --deploy. The direct start-web.sh invokes Gunicorn only. The checks reject disabled verification, while the runtime verification functions honor the setting.

resolved_questions.question: Are web, scheduler and payment one-shot jobs isolated from each other's secrets or media?
resolved_questions.resolution: No separate such control is established: all inherit the same environment, UID and volume configuration. Different commands do not prove reduced authority.

resolved_questions.question: Are timezone support and the settings comment consistent?
resolved_questions.resolution: No. The comment says to ensure timezone support, but USE_TZ is False and TIME_ZONE is Asia/Shanghai.

resolved_questions.question: What remains unresolved for subsequent audit?
resolved_questions.resolution: Actual env values and proxy trust; media confidentiality/publication policy; deployed mobile artifacts and native SDK behavior; final redirect recipients; complete endpoint/caller permission coverage; payment business/idempotency invariants; database grants; backup/restore operational proof; build-context secret inclusion. No hypotheses are promoted to findings by this architecture pass.
